node.statement: Domain conclusion: X_*=U^dagger has the exact right inverse U, and by the involution axiom its defect is ||U bold-dot U^dagger-J||<=2*epsilon_r from 1.2.2. The product X_p=U bold-dot V has a right inverse by 1.2.4 and defect at most 3*epsilon_r by 1.2.3. Since rho>5*epsilon_r, each defect is strictly below 2*rho (if epsilon_r=0, use rho>0 separately). By def-approximate-unitary-space both inputs lie in calU_rho, and 1.1 (lem-stage1-polar-retraction) gives calU_rho subseteq S_delta.
